info.name: kOmudIDAtukramANkaH
info.value: ayaM DAtuH sidDAntakOmudyAm pfTag rUpeRa nEva pAWyate . parantu tatra 10.173 barha ityatra 'kecidiha garja garda Sabde, garDa aBikANkzAyAmiti paWanti' iti nirdeSena ayaM pAWaBedaH jYApitaH asti .

examples: 'niraBrameva cAkASaM prajagarja mahAsvanam' (BA॰Adi॰30.36). stanituM (stanayitum). pracakrame. praSabda AdikarmaRi drazwavyaH.
'SArdUlAviva cAnyonyamAmizArTe'ByagarjatAm' (BA0 droRa0 133.30). aByagarjatAm AhvayetAm, AhUtipUrvamavASyetAm. udanardatAm.

'kfzwAseH pratibimbaM svaM hitvA nAnyo'sya saMmuKaH. nAparaH pratiSabdAcca garjataH pratigarjati' (rAja0 8.1563).. pratigarjati pratidvandvitayA garjati. aho ayonijopamA kaveH. fzIRAM kadanaM kftvA garjati mAmapi pratigarjati. siMho DanaDvaniM pratigarjati. ukto'rTaH.
